scripts.build:win: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.sidecar.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --no-bundle
scripts.build:win:bundle: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.sidecar.conf.json --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis,msi
scripts.build:mac:intel: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs x86_64-apple-darwin && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.sidecar.conf.json --target x86_64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build:mac:apple: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs aarch64-apple-darwin && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.sidecar.conf.json --target aarch64-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
scripts.build:mac:universal: node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs universal-apple-darwin && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.sidecar.conf.json --target universal-apple-darwin --bundles app,dmg
